Name: Cozy Modern Bathroom Furniture
Author: Pixeltica
Description:
[center][img]https://file.garden/aZnNi5K8pRGSceNM/cmb/banner_logo_v6.png[/img][/center]

[b]﻿Welcome to Cozy Modern Furniture Collection! [/b]

My intention for the pack is to bring together the coziness of vanilla and softer tones and a touch of clean and simple modern lines. I hope that you'll find it blends well with both vanilla and custom content thanks to the multiple recolours available. 


[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/qRnK2P5X/banner-whatsnew110-v1.png[/img][/center]

[size=3][b]New in v1.1.0 An Alternative Textures Add-On Pack is now available as optional download - adding ~750 additional recolor options![/b]

[/size]This pack contains additional recolor and customization options for the main Content Patcher pack and will not work without it. It introduces 8 completely new recolor palettes to all items previously available in one of the main four themes (green, blue, pink and brown) as well as many others which did not have any variants before at all. New color palettes are: teal, grape, sunset, mauve, steel, violet, rose, and white:

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/gkpVH0dw/recolorexamples110.png[/img]

And if you are using Happy Home Designer you can spawn the recolors as full items without having to use the AT Tools to target individual items - just look for any items with the golden star and you will see all available AT variants on the right!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/prJn6Dxm/hhdatr.png[/img]


[b]Other updates and changes: see changlogs[/b]

Please let me know if you find anything bugged or broken - with a large update and tidy up I'm sure there will be things I missed.
And as always please feel free to post any ideas/requests in the comments!

[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1W0V6Zr/banner-reqs-v3.png[/img][/center]
[b]Mod and Framework Requirements:
[/b]Main pack is available for Content Patcher ONLY.
There is an Alternative Textures Add-On Pack now available with several hundred more custom options.

To use this furniture pack please make sure to download:
>> [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b] (this is a mandatory requirement!)
>> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628][b]Calcifer[/b] [/url](necessary for the furniture catalogue and custom decoration placement - this is a mandatory requirement!)


To use the Alternative Textures Add-On with additional ~750 extra custom recolor options you have to have Alternative Textures installed in addition to the AT Add-On Pack - the Add-On pack will NOT work without the main mod either as it only matches items that are added by the mod.
>> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures

[/url][b]NOTE: I will not be releasing an Alternative Textures standalone version for this pack as with a total of items being way over 1000, and likely to increase, it's not going to be manageable to assign all custom items to vanilla targets for a smooth experience.[/b]


For the best possible experience I highly recommend the below additional mods which greatly enhance management and interaction with furniture items:
>> [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url][/b] (a much better version of the furniture catalogue with robust categories and search)
>> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233?tab=posts]Anything Anywhere[/url] - allows for placement of furniture without restrictions and, my favourite, for removing rugs without having to pick things up first! - (Unfortunately this has not yet been updated for 1.6.9 but there IS an unofficial update link in the comments. Please make sure to give the official version a download as well to support the original author too)
>> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488?tab=posts]Precise Furniture[/url] - for micro adjustment of furniture placement to allow for a more natural arrangement, lets you arrange things completely off/in-between the grid

[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/2yDZGHpp/banner-where-to-find-v3.png[/img][/center]

[b]You can get the furniture in a few different ways[/b]:

>> Vanilla Furniture Catalogue 
>> Custom Cozy Modern Bathroom Furniture Catalogue - you can purchase it from Robin for 50,000g 
>> Happy Home Designer Catalogue or Architects Catalogue
>> Or spawn them directly using CJB Item Spawner

The pack also contains a [b]CONFIGURATION [/b]option where you can disable certain parts of the mod if you find that your catalogue has become too cluttered - you will find an option to disable individual recolours for the wood framed furniture and rugs. It is highly recommended to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change these without needing to restart the game.

[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zvCnYswX/banner-contents-v4.png[/img][/center]

[b]Base Pack Content Details in Version 1.0.0[/b]
The pack currently adds about 750 items comprising of
>> bathroom fixtures, such as: bathtubs, showers, sinks, etc
>> windows with roman and ﻿venetian style blinds, they let natural daylight in, and darken at night
>> small set of wall lights (sconces) 
>> a large collection of rotatable bathroom mats in 4 vibrant and 4 more pastel colours (in  [b]blue, green, pink and brown[/b])
>> and finally, a collection of (mostly!) wood framed furniture 

all items in that category come in 8 different recolours:
﻿>> vanilla [b]oak[/b], [b]walnut [/b]and [b]birch[/b];
﻿>> [b]softer [/b]vanilla [b]oak[/b], [b]walnut [/b]and [b]birch [/b](desaturated, meant for those preferring colours closer to Earthy Interiors)
﻿>> and two entirely custom ones: [b]cedar [/b](a warm soft brown wood colour) and [b]gloss white[/b]

Plus: the lovely PIF room in the screenshot is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28043]Kisaa's Tiny Rooms Pack for PIF[/url] - which was also the spark that inspired me to make this pack <3

[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/3wzp48nx/banner-thanks-v4.png[/img][/center]

I really hope you enjoy this collection! This is my first complete set of totally custom furniture, and with over 750 items, there are likely some bugs and things I missed. If you do find anything, please report it in the comments. Thanks!

If you have any suggestions for this pack, or any other furniture pieces in this style (as I am already working on the main farmhouse pack) please feel free to drop them here as well. You can also find me in the Main Stardew Valley Discord if you have any other questions.

[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/KY1B8k7W/banner-other-work-v4.png[/img][/center]
